ITEM 1 | Two wedge-shaped slices of baked flatbread-style crust, golden-orange with a melted pale yellow-white cheese layer and small red-orange tomato-sauce patches, cheese partly browned in spots, two round pepperoni-like discs about 2.5 cm across with slightly curled edges and glossy red-orange sheen, sitting at the upper right edge of the plate, one slice's crust edge about 1.5 cm thick, total footprint roughly 10 percent of the plate | 120

ITEM 2 | Thick-cut orange-red vegetable rounds and wedges, glossy and moist with slight sheen, some with a dark green herb or seed tucked into a cut center, arranged in a cluster to the right of center, pieces about 3 to 4 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm thick, edges slightly soft and holding shape | 90

ITEM 3 | Cubes of pale off-white firm block, about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, matte surface with slight golden browning on some faces, some cubes with a light crumb-like texture, scattered in the center-lower area of the plate beside a dark green herb sprig | 60

ITEM 4 | Chunks of browned, slightly glossy grilled vegetable pieces in dark olive-brown and tan tones, irregular shapes about 2 to 3 cm, some with charred edges and a faint oily sheen, sitting at the lower right of the plate next to the orange vegetables | 55

ITEM 5 | Long orange carrot-like sticks, roughly 5 cm long and 1 cm wide, glossy with slight moisture, one piece lying diagonally at the bottom center of the plate, some with a slightly darker cooked edge | 30

ITEM 6 | Scattered small tan-brown granular pieces, about 0.3 to 0.5 cm each, dry and matte, sprinkled across the plate surface and near the vegetables, a few crumbs of similar color | 5
